title: AI agent runs amok in Fedora and elsewhere
description: An AI agent went rogue, causing chaos in Fedora and other systems. The incident sparked widespread discussion about AI agent safety and sandboxing. (537 points, 240 comments on HN)

title: A €0.01 bank transfer could compromise a banking AI agent
description: Security researchers demonstrated how a one-cent bank transfer could compromise a banking AI agent, highlighting critical vulnerabilities in financial AI assistants. (204 points, 195 comments on HN)

title: Apache Burr: Build reliable AI agents and applications
description: Apache released Burr, a new open-source framework for building reliable AI agents and agent-based applications, gaining significant community attention. (242 points, 113 comments on HN)

title: Coinbase launches AI agent accounts that can trade and spend on your behalf
description: Coinbase introduced AI agent accounts that enable autonomous trading and spending, marking a significant step toward agent-driven financial services.

title: He Hacked Teslas for Elon Musk. Now He's Launching a $100M AI Cyber Agent
description: A hacker previously known for hacking Teslas for Elon Musk is launching a $100 million AI cybersecurity agent startup, signaling growing investment in autonomous security agents.

title: Cybersecurity researchers aren't happy about the guardrails on Anthropic's Fable
description: Security researchers expressed frustration over Anthropic's strict guardrails on its Fable model, which limit legitimate security testing and AI agent safety research. (579 points, 509 comments on HN)

title: The AI Agent in the Billing Department of Verizon Is a Mentally Handicapped Thug
description: A scathing critique of Verizon's AI billing agent, documenting how poorly-implemented customer service AI agents can harm user experience. (26 points, 9 comments on HN)

title: Terms of Service Ban AI Agents from Using Stack Overflow for Agents
description: Stack Overflow updated its terms of service to explicitly ban AI agents from scraping or using its content, reflecting growing tension between content platforms and AI agent ecosystems.

title: Robinhood now lets your AI agents trade stocks
description: Robinhood introduced API capabilities allowing AI agents to autonomously trade stocks, opening the door for algorithmic and agent-driven retail trading. (112 points on HN)

title: Apple Passwords Now Auto Fixes Weak and Compromised Passwords with Agentic AI
description: Apple's Password app now uses agentic AI to automatically fix weak and compromised passwords, demonstrating practical consumer application of AI agents for security.

title: Apple's Siri-AI, or more shouting into the void about 'private' agents
description: A critical analysis of Apple's claims about private AI agents in Siri, questioning whether truly private agentic AI is technically feasible with current architectures.

title: Your AI Agent Is Compromised
description: Trend Micro published research showing how AI agents are already being compromised by attackers, highlighting the growing attack surface of agentic AI systems in production environments.

title: Miasma Worm Hits Microsoft Again – Supply Chain Attack Targeting AI Coding Agents
description: A worm named Miasma exploited supply chain vulnerabilities in Microsoft's ecosystem, specifically targeting repositories used by AI coding agents, highlighting risks in agent-driven development pipelines.

title: Local firewall for AI Agents that cuts tokens usage and cost by 40-70%
description: A new open-source local firewall for AI agents that blocks secret leaks and reduces API token costs by 40-70%, addressing two critical pain points in AI agent deployment.

title: GEDD – Grounded Eval-Driven Development for AI Agents
description: AWS released GEDD, a framework for grounded evaluation-driven development of AI agents, providing tools to systematically test and improve agent reliability.
